title: [CQ-M07b1] executionReadiness: pin three edge rows QA mutants survived
description:
A test-only follow-up from CQ-M07b QA round 3 (qa-c5835a34, 2026-11-01). The landed evaluator (completion 3c30b30a) behaves correctly. But no row in executionReadiness.test.ts pins three of its guards, so a refactor could drop any of them with the suite still green.

QA proved each gap in a git-archive copy. The three rows below pass on the original module (117/117), and each matching mutant fails exactly its own row. The harness is /tmp/moe-qa-c5835a34-mut/pin.py.

Add these rows to packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts and change no other file:
1. ALONE table: 'a valid key reached through a directory symlinked into the project'.
   - Setup: symlinkSync(dir(project, 'secret'), path.join(root, 'keys-link'), 'junction'), then runnerKeyPath = await keyFor(project, path.join(root, 'keys-link')).
   - Expect exactly ['authenticated-runner-evidence'].
   - Why: realpath(keyPath) in runnerKeyFiled is the only guard against an intermediate-directory symlink into the project. lstat and O_NOFOLLOW cover only the final component.
2. PROBES table: a rejection { killed: false, signal: 'SIGKILL', code: null } gives provider-probe-failed.
   - Why: an external kill is not execFile's timeout. This kills the mutant where timedOut keys on signal instead of killed.
3. ALONE table, POSIX only: a daemonInstallDir whose directory name contains a real newline character expects exactly ['protected-host-control-plane'].
   - Why: this kills the mutant where absolute() drops the CONTROL test.

Size: about 10 test lines. No runtime change.
definitionOfDone: A row where runnerKeyPath reaches a valid key through a directory symlinked into the project expects exactly ['authenticated-runner-evidence']. It fails when runnerKeyFiled compares the unresolved keyPath instead of realpath(keyPath).

A probe rejection { killed: false, signal: 'SIGKILL', code: null } expects exactly ['isolated-agent-and-qa-vms', 'isolated-check-vm', 'provider-probe-failed']. It fails when timedOut keys on signal instead of killed.
On POSIX, a daemonInstallDir whose name contains a control character expects exactly ['protected-host-control-plane']. It fails when absolute() drops the CONTROL test.

executionReadiness.ts and runnerChannel.ts are byte-unchanged. The CQ-M07b archive gate (npm ci, tsc --noEmit, then vitest over executionReadiness.test.ts and runnerChannel.test.ts) passes in a git-archive snapshot, never in the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
Add the three rows to packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts, using the Edit tool only (global rail). Change no other file. The rows pin the evaluator's existing error handling; there is no runtime change. Reuse the file's own helpers (dir, keyFor, rejecting, root, project) and its tables.

1. DoD 1, in the ALONE table (row type: [name, id, setup returning Over | null | Promise<Over>]):
['a valid key reached through a directory symlinked into the project', 'authenticated-runner-evidence', async () => { symlinkSync(dir(project, 'secret'), path.join(root, 'keys-link'), 'junction'); return { runnerKeyPath: await keyFor(project, path.join(root, 'keys-link')) }; }]
- keyFor files the REAL key through the link, so only realpath(keyPath) in runnerKeyFiled (executionReadiness.ts:150) sees that it lives inside the project. lstat and O_NOFOLLOW check only the final component.
- A Windows EPERM on the junction is already skipped by the table's it.for.

2. DoD 2, in the PROBES table:
['an externally SIGKILLed client', rejecting({ killed: false, signal: 'SIGKILL', code: null }), 'provider-probe-failed']
- The table's it.each already asserts [...ISOLATION, id], i.e. exactly ['isolated-agent-and-qa-vms', 'isolated-check-vm', 'provider-probe-failed'], with the evidence still named.
- timedOut (:164) keys on killed === true, not on the signal.

3. DoD 3, in the ALONE table, POSIX only:
['an install path whose name holds a control character', 'protected-host-control-plane', () => (process.platform === 'win32' ? null : { daemonInstallDir: dir(root, 'inst\nall') })]
- The directory must REALLY exist, outside the project and disjoint from it, so that the ONLY refusal is absolute()'s CONTROL test (:102-107). A missing directory would also fail realpath, and the mutant would survive.
- null on win32 uses the table's existing ctx.skip().

Unit tests never spawn a real Multipass client (task rail): every row uses the injected runProbe.
implementationPlan.note: Added three rows (ALONE x2, PROBES x1) with Edit tool.

Expect EXIT 0, tsc clean, and on Linux every test passing with none skipped: 114 + 3 = 117 in executionReadiness.test.ts plus 41 in runnerChannel.test.ts, unless a peer has landed more rows. The leading git diff proves DoD 4: this task leaves executionReadiness.ts and runnerChannel.ts byte-unchanged.

Mutants, in the same snapshot and never in the checkout. Back up src/delivery/executionReadiness.ts, apply each mutant with sed, run `npx vitest run src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts`, and restore the backup after each one. Each mutant must fail its own new row:
- M1: `[await realpath(keyPath), await project]` becomes `[keyPath, await project]`. Row 1 must fail.
- M2: in timedOut, `error.killed === true` becomes `error.signal === 'SIGKILL'`. Row 2 must fail.
- M3: drop `&& !CONTROL.test(value)` from absolute. Row 3 must fail.
Record each mutant's failing test names in complete_step, and `cmp` the restored module with HEAD's copy before finishing.

Self-review: is any row vacuous? (For example, does the newline directory really exist, and is the junction really inside the project?) Is any row platform-fragile beyond the existing win32 skips? Did any byte outside the test file change?
